about.text: Mild, semi-soft cow's milk cheese with a creamy texture and distinctive orange rind. Excellent for melting in sandwiches and burgers, and pairs well with light beers and fruits. A milder counterpart to the stronger French Munster.

sources.text: Pasteurised cow's milk, very mild, orange rind coloured with annatto; American imitation of Alsatian Munster
